source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of writing files (PDF 62).

blocks.text: File mein likhne ke liye usay write mode ("w") mein kholein aur write() method istemal karein. Purane data ke baad aur data jorna ho to append mode ("a") istemal karein.

#    Writing to a file
with open("example.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write("As-Salaam-Alaikum, World!\n")
#    Appending to a file
with open("example.txt", "a") as file:
    file.write("Appending new line.\n")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"#    Writing to a file" aur "#    Appending to a file": comments.
"with open("example.txt", "w") as file:": "w" (write) mode file banata hai, aur pehle se ho to us ka purana data mita deta hai.
"file.write("As-Salaam-Alaikum, World!\n")": yeh line file mein likhta hai; "\n" ka matlab hai nayi line.
"with open("example.txt", "a") as file:": "a" (append) mode purana data rakhta hai aur naya data aakhir mein jorta hai.
"file.write("Appending new line.\n")": doosri line aakhir mein jurti hai.
Is program mein print nahi, is liye screen par kuch nahi aata; nateeja example.txt file mein hai jis mein ab do lines hain: "As-Salaam-Alaikum, World!" aur "Appending new line.".

blocks.prompt: Dono blocks chalne ke baad example.txt mein kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Do lines: "As-Salaam-Alaikum, World!" aur "Appending new line."

blocks.text: Program pehle "w" mode se pehli line likhta hai, phir "a" mode se doosri line aakhir mein jorta hai aur file parh kar dikhata hai. Dono lines badal kar Run karein.

first_line = "As-Salaam-Alaikum, World!"
second_line = "Python is fun."
with open("example.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write(first_line + "\n")
with open("example.txt", "a") as file:
    file.write(second_line + "\n")
with open("example.txt", "r") as file:
    print(file.read())

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"first_line" aur "second_line": file mein likhne ke liye do lines.
"with open("example.txt", "w") as file:" aur "file.write(first_line + "\n")": file nayi bana kar (ya purani mita kar) pehli line likhta hai; "\n" line khatam karta hai.
"with open("example.txt", "a") as file:" aur "file.write(second_line + "\n")": purani line rehti hai aur doosri aakhir mein jurti hai.
"with open("example.txt", "r") as file:" aur "print(file.read())": file parh kar poora text dikhata hai.
Output: "As-Salaam-Alaikum, World!" aur "Python is fun.", phir ek khaali line: file ki aakhri "\n" aur print ki apni nayi line mil kar yeh khaali line banati hain.
Khud try karein: second_line = "I like coding." kar ke Run karein: doosri line "I like coding." ho jayegi.

items: "w": mita kar likho; "a": aakhir mein joro.
